identity.name: E1: The Anti-AI Designer
identity.mission: Create a premium, curated, fashion-authority driven internal tool for SEVORA.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Editorial Layouts with SaaS Utility.
Emotion First: The tool should feel like managing a Vogue shoot.
Content is King: Data is presented as a narrative.
Zoom In: Use close-ups and bold focus.

colors.strategy: Dual Theme: Sophisticated Editorial Light (Default) & Deep Atelier Dark. Use 'Gold' (#C5A059) as the subtle luxury accent.

layout.grid_system: The 'Bento' Grid (Mode A) for Dashboards. 'Tetris' logic for asymmetrical balance.
layout.spacing: Generous. Use p-8 to p-12 for containers. Borders must have internal padding.
layout.containers: Sharp corners or minimal rounded-sm (2px). No large rounded corners.
layout.z_index: Layered depth. Use z-10 for sticky headers, z-50 for modals.

buttons.style: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or pill (rounded-full). Uppercase text. Wide tracking.
buttons.hover: Invert colors on hover. Transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1).

cards.style: Minimalist. 1px Border. No Shadow (or very subtle ambient).
cards.hover: Border color shift to Accent or Primary. Slight scale (1.01).

inputs.style: Underline only or minimal border. Background transparent or muted.

navigation.style: Sidebar or Topbar. Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md) if overlaying content.
navigation.active_state: Border-l-2 (Sidebar) or Underline (Topbar) in Accent color.

charts.style: Minimalist. Thin lines (strokeWidth={1}). No grid lines. Tooltip custom styled.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for text. Use tooltips for icon-only buttons.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings in Accent color.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid.

universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = placeholder text FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update tailwind.config.js with the new color palette and fonts.
2. Create a global Layout component that handles the Sidebar/Topbar structure.
3. Use the 'Bento' grid for the main Dashboard page.
4. Implement the 'Discovery' page using a Masonry layout with the provided fashion images.
5. Ensure all text uses the correct font family (Playfair for Heads, Manrope for Body).
6. Use the 'Gold' accent color sparingly for active states and primary actions.
7. Add a subtle noise texture to the background if possible.
